hero.subtitle: Virtual workshops and classes leading up to an in-person quantum computing competition at ITBA.

about.title: What is QuantumJam?
about.description: A Computer Society ITBA event in two independent parts: a series of virtual workshops and classes, followed by an in-person quantum computing competition at ITBA.

beginner.title: No prior experience needed
beginner.desc: We start from scratch: what a qubit is and what superposition means.

hands_on.title: Hands-on with Qiskit
hands_on.desc: Build and run your first circuit on real IBM hardware.

community.title: Community
community.desc: Technical talks and networking with the Buenos Aires quantum community.

hardware.title: The hardware
hardware.description: IBM Quantum processors hold each qubit in a superconducting chip cooled to millikelvins above absolute zero. Every gold plate of the cryostat shields and progressively cools the chip: gold is the material that best conducts and protects at those temperatures.

workshops.label: Virtual workshops
workshops.desc: Regular online sessions on our Discord server. Registration required.

competition.label: Competition day
competition.desc: November 14, in person at ITBA SDF.

sponsor.title: IBM Quantum
sponsor.description: IBM Quantum provides the workshop with real quantum hardware: superconducting processors at millikelvin temperatures, controlled with microwave pulses.

hardware.label: Hardware
hardware.value: Live access to IBM's superconducting quantum processors, the same ones used in production.

software.label: Software
software.value: Qiskit, the open-source SDK used to build and run every circuit at the workshops.

support.label: Support
support.value: Technical guidance for teams throughout the competition.

registerSelect.title: Sign Up
